728-7084-8347.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Sela triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

539-3821-4247-4679-6023.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-3821-4247-4679-6023.description:
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat

339-677-1753-8095.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1429-3545-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Sigil Captain triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2719-7936.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2719-7936.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Sakashima of a Thousand Faces and Dominion Saboteur each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Dominion Saboteur trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2719-7936.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

475-1379-4186-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-1379-4186-6824.description:
Gain life in any way.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

511-817-1270-4050-7704.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating three creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1676-5231-6972.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Boss's Chauffeur.
When Boss's Chauffeur dies, its persist ability and second ability trigger.
Resolve the second trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Citizen creature tokens equal to the number of +1/+1 counters that were on Boss's Chauffeur.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Boss's Chauffeur from your graveyard to the battlefield. It'll enter with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the number of creatures you control minus 1 due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2185-5686-6972.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Howlgeist
When Howlgeist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Howlgeist
When Howlgeist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Shilgengar abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2185-5686-6972.notes: If Howlgeist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

5660-7435.easyPrerequisites: You have a permanent card in your graveyard.
5660-7435.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
5660-7435.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning a permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
Hardened Academic triggers. Holding priority, activate Hardened Academic by discarding the permanent card.
Resolve the Hardened Academic trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Repeat from step 2.

3717-7282-7340.description:
Activate Viridian Joiner by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Sewer-veillance Cam.
When the Sewer-veillance Cam token enters, it triggers, untapping Viridian Joiner.
Repeat.

339-677-6974-7296.manaNeeded: {3} if Ashling's Command is in your hand
339-677-6974-7296.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
If Ashling's Command is in your graveyard, activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Ashling's Command from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. Otherwise, cast Ashling's Command by paying {3}{U}{R}.
Resolve Ashling's Command, creating a token copy of Jegantha and choosing any of its remaining modes.
Put the tapped Jegantha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat using the Jegantha token.

2919-4094-5086-5183-5231.easyPrerequisites:
Kaya has two or more loyalty counters on it.
Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2919-4094-5086-5183-5231.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}
Repeat from step 2.

1719-4785-7163.easyPrerequisites: You are able to put a triggered ability on the stack.
1719-4785-7163.description:
Put any triggered ability on the stack.
Holding priority, activate Dynaheir by tapping it.
Activate Mister Fantastic by paying {R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, targeting the ability from step 1.
Dynaheir triggers. Holding priority, activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Mister Fantastic.
Activate Mister Fantastic by paying {R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, copying Dynaheir's trigger twice
Resolve the first copy of Dynaheir's trigger, copying Mister Fantastic's ability, targeting Dynaheir's trigger
Resolve the copy of Mister Fantastic's ability, copying Dynaheir's trigger twice.
Repeat from step 6

275-2034-4871-6747-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Transplant Theorist by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Sami.
Repeat.

3459-3755-5078-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
3459-3755-5078-6650.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

4955-5465-7070.description:
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Grafted Wargear ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Doc Aurlock.
Repeat.

2173-2324-4905-5220.description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Proper Burial trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

224-277-907-3314-3430.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using three in any combination of {G} and/or {W}, and have the mana to cast it.
224-277-907-3314-3430.description:
Cast the creature in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it, Tiller Engine and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Selesnya Sanctuary.
Holding priority, activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{W}{W}{W} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from your hand to the battlefield.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Chulane.
Resolve the creature spell cast in step 1.
Activate Chulane by paying {3} and tapping it, returning the creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2511-4853-6810.easyPrerequisites: You've sacrificed an artifact this turn.
2511-4853-6810.description:
Activate Detective's Satchel by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Thopter.
When the Thopter dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Detective's Satchel.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1339-5349-6753.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four tokens.
1339-5349-6753.description:
Activate Izoni by sacrificing four tokens, causing you to surveil 2, draw two cards, and gain 2 life.
The Locust God triggers twice, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens with haste.
Repeat.

1329-1558-6704.easyPrerequisites:
Other creatures you control have power 3 or greater.
An opponent cannot block RMS Titanic.
1329-1558-6704.description:
Activate RMS Titanic's crew ability by tapping any number of creatures with power 3 or greater, causing it to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using RMS Titanic, triggering its ability, causing you to sacrifice it and create at least seven Treasure tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast RMS Titanic from your graveyard this turn.
Cast RMS Titanic from your graveyard by paying {3}{R}.
Repeat each turn.

855-4968-6593.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Corpsejack Menace.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
855-4968-6593.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar if desired.

2073-2707-3617-6504.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Time Walk each turn.
2073-2707-3617-6504.description:
If Conjurer's Bauble is in your graveyard, activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, putting Time Walk onto the bottom of your library from your graveyard, and then causing you to draw Time Walk from the bottom of your library due to River Song.
Repeat each turn.

224-5627-6528.notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
224-5627-6528.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Elfsworn Giant and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Repeat.

631-5231-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
631-5231-6249--5.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the persist creature, adding {R}.
When the persist creature dies, it and Grim Haruspex trigger.
Resolve the Grim Haruspex trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Repeat.

1308-2457-4068-4289.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
1308-2457-4068-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1636-3143-4680.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
1636-3143-4680.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing another creature you control, causing you to proliferate.
Venser triggers, creating a 3/3 The Hollow Sentinel legendary artifact creature token.
When The Hollow Sentinel enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2084-5134.manaNeeded: {1}{U} plus enough mana to cast the copy spell
2084-5134.description:
Cast Fated Infatuation by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
Activate the Mirror-Mad Phantasm token by paying {1}{U}, shuffling the token into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control that does not have summoning sickness

2238-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2238-3259.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Goblin Rabblemaster triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
2238-3259.notes: You can also attack with Goblin Rabblemaster, which'll continually increase its power as it attacks.

562-2904.description:
Activate Warrior en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting Cephalid Illusionist.
Cephalid Illusionist triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve the Warrior en-Kor ability.
Repeat.
